name: quandora-staging
description: Quandora Staging plugin with Factor, Strategy, Strategy Portfolio, analysis, and Paper Trading skills.

interface.shortDescription: Use staging Quandora services from your agent.
interface.longDescription: Quandora Staging packages Factor Mining, Factor Analysis, Strategy Building, Strategy Portfolio, Strategy Analysis, and Paper Trading. Strategy Portfolio owns multi-Strategy composition and exact source-reuse evaluation; Paper Trading owns only simulated execution from completed evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use Quandora Staging Factor Mining with my custom factor idea.
Use Quandora Staging Strategy Portfolio to combine exact StrategyVersions and evaluate exact completed source runs.
Use Quandora Staging Paper Trading to select an eligible source run and start a simulated run after confirmation.
